source: 2015/TSB Vol 15 No 16 - NEW CAT Tool II.pdf
title: Cleaner Application Tool II
lead: MOC has developed a new Cleaner Application Tool (Part No. 72480), which includes the hose assembly that was designed to service vehicles with return-less fuel systems. (See Technical Service Bulletin Vol. 15 No. 12 for information on the return-less fuel system tool). This new Cleaner Application Tool also includes a 2nd pressure gauge attached to the air regulator.
